notes: hard bucket (sum 18). Multiple independent sub-problems bound by exact contracts: cross-compiling hop.c to a little-endian MIPS ELF that must reproduce native 32-bit-wraparound checksums when run under qemu-user-static; rewriting a g95-frontend Makefile to gfortran with the module-compiled-before-program invariant; a C/C++ polyglot proven under both toolchains; a C CLI whose particle positions/summary/stdout must match a Python reference byte-for-byte; an autoregressive arg-max sampler whose stdout must equal an external Python launcher's reference (32-bit wrap + non-negative modulo equality between C and Python); a release-key file that stays valid when the host recompiles the sampler from source (recompile independence, guarded against tampered binaries); and a metacircular Scheme-Lite evaluator (env chains, closures, eval/apply). hidden tails probe mips boards, fortran angles, launch (len,seed), extra seeds, cli counts, and two scheme programs.
